article_title: Cancer 'sponge' tests for bad indigestion could be offered to more people

tasks.prompt: What change do the draft NHS guidelines recommend?
options: Offering quick sponge tests more widely to people with persistent indigestion
Replacing every cancer test with a blood test
Stopping long-term monitoring after a negative result
Closing GP surgeries that cannot perform endoscopy
tasks.correct_answer: Offering quick sponge tests more widely to people with persistent indigestion
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההמלצה היא להרחיב את השימוש בבדיקת הספוג לאנשים עם צרבת או קלקול קיבה מתמשך, כדי לאתר שינויים מדאיגים.

tasks.prompt: How does the sponge collect cells from the oesophagus?
options: A camera photographs cells in the stomach
A capsule releases a sponge that is pulled back out by its thread
A blood sample is taken after a meal
The patient wears a sensor for one week
tasks.correct_answer: A capsule releases a sponge that is pulled back out by its thread
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המטופל בולע קפסולה המחוברת לחוט; היא מתמוססת, משחררת ספוג קטן שאוסף תאים בעת שליפתו.

tasks.prompt: What condition linked to long-term cancer risk can be caused by persistent reflux?
options: Lung fibrosis
Diabetes
Barrett's oesophagus
Kidney stones
tasks.explanation_hebrew: רפלוקס ממושך עלול להיות קשור ל-Barrett's oesophagus, מצב שבו תאי רירית הוושט מתחילים להשתנות.

tasks.prompt: What does “less invasive” mean when the sponge test is compared with endoscopy?
options: It costs more money
It takes place only in hospital
It gives a guaranteed diagnosis
It involves less entry into or disturbance of the body
tasks.correct_answer: It involves less entry into or disturbance of the body
tasks.explanation_hebrew: less invasive פירושו שהבדיקה חודרת פחות לגוף ומכבידה פחות על המטופל לעומת אנדוסקופיה עם מצלמה.

tasks.prompt: Approximately how common is Barrett's oesophagus among adults?
options: Between one and two in every 100 adults
One in every two adults
Fewer than one in a million adults
Exactly 25 in every 100 adults
tasks.correct_answer: Between one and two in every 100 adults
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, בין מבוגר אחד לשניים מכל מאה סובלים מ-Barrett's oesophagus.

tasks.prompt: In the report, what does “all-clear” mean?
options: The test equipment has been cleaned
The result shows no concerning changes were found
The patient will never need monitoring again
The capsule has fully dissolved
tasks.correct_answer: The result shows no concerning changes were found
tasks.explanation_hebrew: all-clear מתאר תוצאה שלא נמצאו בה סימנים מדאיגים, אך הכתבה מדגישה שעדיין נדרש מעקב ארוך טווח.

tasks.prompt: How could wider sponge testing reduce pressure on NHS services?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הקשר בין מקום הבדיקה, אנדוסקופיות ומשאבים.
expected_points: The test can be completed in minutes at a GP surgery
It is simpler and less invasive than hospital endoscopy
It can identify who actually needs further tests or treatment
It may reduce demand for more complicated endoscopies
Freed resources could help the NHS find cancers earlier

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the sponge test works, who it may help and its main limitation.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את שלבי הבדיקה, אוכלוסיית היעד והצורך במעקב גם לאחר תוצאה תקינה.
expected_points: It may be offered to people with persistent indigestion or reflux
The patient swallows a dissolving capsule attached to a thread
The released sponge collects oesophageal cells as it is pulled out
The cells are analysed for Barrett's oesophagus or cancer-related changes
No diagnostic test detects every case, so a negative result still requires long-term monitoring

tasks.prompt: Why should a patient with a negative sponge-test result continue to be monitored?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את מגבלת הרגישות של בדיקות אבחון ואת הסיכון המתמשך.
expected_points: No diagnostic test identifies every case
The sponge test can miss concerning changes
Endoscopy can also miss cases
Barrett's oesophagus carries a long-term cancer risk
Monitoring can detect later changes

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph explaining one benefit and one caution of offering sponge tests more widely.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג יתרון מעשי או רפואי לצד מגבלה ברורה מתוך הכתבה.
expected_points: Benefits include a quick GP-based and less invasive check
It may reduce unnecessary endoscopies and identify people needing treatment
It may give patients peace of mind
A negative result is not a guarantee
Patients should still receive appropriate long-term monitoring
